Theo van den Berg, 94  
📞 +91 9876543210 | 📧 theovan denberg@example.com | 📍 Mumbai, India  

A seasoned machine learning engineer with 8 years of expertise in crafting AI systems for dynamic gaming environments. Specializing in the intersection of reinforcement learning, natural language processing, and computer vision, I have architected scalable architectures that enhance player engagement and NPC behavior. My work spans recommendation systems, cross-platform AI integration, and production-grade MLOps pipelines, with a track record of delivering measurable impact through algorithmic innovation and technical leadership.  

At NexaGame Studios, I led the development of cross-platform AI systems that integrate natural language processing and computer vision to create adaptive game worlds. This involved designing reinforcement learning frameworks that reduced player churn by 18% through personalized NPC interactions. I also spearheaded the deployment of PyTorch-based models on GCP, achieving 92% inference latency reduction. My team’s work on MLOps pipelines using MLflow and Weights & Biases enabled seamless model versioning, supporting 15+ concurrent feature rollouts.  

Previously, as Principal ML Engineer at Vortex Play, I scaled reinforcement learning pipelines for NPC behavior optimization, leveraging Apache Spark to process 200M+ gameplay events daily. This resulted in a 30% improvement in dynamic difficulty adjustment accuracy. I also designed REST APIs for real-time feedback integration, which reduced server response times by 25%. My focus on NLP-driven dialogue systems led to a 22% increase in player retention in open-world titles.  

At Lumina Interactive, my role as Junior ML Engineer centered on building recommendation systems for game content personalization. I developed collaborative filtering models using TensorFlow, which increased user session duration by 15%. This work laid the foundation for later initiatives in recommendation algorithm optimization, including the integration of deep learning techniques to improve prediction accuracy by 12%.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Computer Vision**: Engineered vision-based systems for NPC behavior analysis, reducing manual annotation efforts by 40% through YOLOv5 integration. Developed real-time object tracking pipelines for 500K+ concurrent players, achieving 98% precision in action recognition.  
- **NLP**: Architectured multilingual dialogue systems supporting 12 languages, reducing localization delays by 35%. Designed transformer-based models for intent classification, improving response accuracy by 28% in dynamic quest systems.  
- **Model Deployment**: Designed microservices for PyTorch and TensorFlow models, enabling 95%+ deployment success rate across 10+ game titles. Mentored 5+ engineers on model serving best practices, reducing deployment bottlenecks by 40%.  
- **TensorFlow & PyTorch**: Central to all AI initiatives, including a custom reinforcement learning framework for dynamic loot systems that increased player satisfaction scores by 17%.  
- **MLOps**: Implemented MLflow for experiment tracking, reducing model retraining time by 20%. Built W&B dashboards for hyperparameter optimization, achieving 30% faster convergence in training pipelines.  
- **AWS & GCP**: Utilized AWS Lambda for serverless model inference, cutting infrastructure costs by 25%. Leveraged GCP’s AI Platform for scalable training, supporting 10x more concurrent workloads.  
- **Apache Spark & Docker**: Processed 500M+ gameplay events daily using Spark, ensuring real-time analytics for player behavior. Containerized AI models using Docker, achieving 90% reproducibility across development and production environments.  
- **REST API Design**: Developed APIs for game telemetry integration, reducing data latency by 22%. Standardized API protocols across 8+ game engines, improving cross-team collaboration by 35%.
